whatsappMessage:
Hi Team A Thousand Cups,

I noticed your café has strong 4.7★ reviews in North Mandiri, Buddha Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu inquiries.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special menu showcase, aur café timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/thousandcups

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team A Thousand Cups, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and menu showcase for your Buddha Colony location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
